summary: Change spanning two repos; the handoff is written in one repo but the unfinished work is in the other.

facts.fact: Goal: rename amount_cents to amount_minor across ledger-api and ledger-web (the old name is wrong for JPY and three-digit currencies).
API side is done: ledger-api branch feat/amount-minor, PR #214, CI green; it serves both amount_minor and amount_cents.
Constraint: the API must keep serving amount_cents until ledger-web is deployed, and the alias is removed only in the release after 2026-10-15.
The remaining work is in the sibling repo ../ledger-web on branch chore/amount-minor, not in ledger-api.
Remaining in ledger-web: src/pages/Summary.tsx still uses amount_cents. types.ts and InvoiceRow.tsx are already updated (uncommitted).
Acceptance check: npx tsc --noEmit in ledger-web passes.
Generating types with openapi-typescript was tried and abandoned because the output collided with the hand-written types.
Environment: the API dev server runs on port 8081, not 8080 (Keycloak uses 8080); the web client needs VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8081.
Deferred to a separate ticket: formatMoney divides by 100, which is wrong for JPY.

traps.trap: Plans to remove amount_cents from the API now or as part of this work.
Proposes generating types with openapi-typescript for this change.
Places the remaining Summary.tsx work in ledger-api, or can't locate ledger-web.
Includes the formatMoney/JPY fix in the next step.
